content: Eligibility: All Trinity College students with a valid @trincoll.edu email address can use the shuttle service. You must verify your email in the app to activate your account. Faculty and staff are also eligible with their Trinity email addresses.

Safety Policy: For everyone's safety, students are required to wear masks if they feel unwell. Please maintain respectful behavior toward drivers and fellow passengers. Follow all driver instructions, especially during emergency situations. The driver has the authority to refuse service if safety guidelines are not followed.

Capacity Limit: Each shuttle has a maximum capacity of 15 passengers to ensure comfort and safety. During peak times (class changes, meal times), you may need to wait for the next shuttle. The app will show you how full each shuttle is in real-time.

Weather Policy: Shuttles operate in all weather conditions unless it becomes unsafe. During severe weather (heavy snow, ice storms), service may be temporarily suspended. Check the app for real-time weather-related alerts and updates.
Lost and Found: If you leave something on the shuttle, contact Campus Safety at 860-297-2222 as soon as possible. Items are held for 30 days. You can also report lost items through the app.

Conduct Policy: The shuttle is an extension of the campus and all Trinity College policies apply. This includes the student code of conduct. Disruptive behavior, vandalism, or harassment will not be tolerated and may result in loss of shuttle privileges.
